svg.title: 履歴書作成を自動化
svg.desc: Googleフォームとスプレッドシートで回答を受け取り、Googleドライブとドキュメントで履歴書を作成・保存し、最後にGmailで送信する3段階の流れ。自動化を大きく強調したサムネイル。
svg.metadata:
Icon sources for google-forms-profile.svg
Original thumbnail layout, typography and process arrows by 31916. Five real Google product logos are embedded as SVG paths. Logos retain their source shapes and colors; only layout and scale are changed. No application screenshot is imitated or generated. The 2020 logo set matches the existing Sheets, Docs and Gmail materials; it is not described as the latest logo set. Google retains its relevant trademark rights. This is an independent tutorial.

Design-method reference: アトオシとデザイン — Illustratorでバナーデザイン。サムネイルデザイン。プロのすべての手順。5作例のコツ。表現のつくりわけ。 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gdJ40oe0vhs The primary/secondary text hierarchy and purpose-appropriate type and color were studied. The tutorial's images, sample layouts and lettering are not copied.
